user.title: Connect your FYES home
user.description: Every FYES light, shutter, sensor, thermostat, scenario and the alarm will appear in Home Assistant, live. FYES stays in charge: commands go through the same path as the FYES app.

email.title: Sign in to FYES
email.description: Enter the email you use in the FYES app. We will email you a 6-digit code.

data_description.email: The email of your FYES account.

data_description.url: Leave as it is unless you run your own FYES server (for example a local hub).

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.

home.title: Pick a home
home.description: Which FYES home should Home Assistant show? You can add more homes later.

token.title: Use a token
token.description: Create a token in the FYES app: Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant. It starts with fyes_.

data_description.token: The token is shown only once in the app. You can revoke it there at any time.

data_description.url: Leave as it is unless you run your own FYES server (for example a local hub).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to FYES again
reauth_confirm.description: FYES no longer accepts the connection for {home} (the token was revoked or your access changed). Sign in again to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Change the FYES server
reconfigure.description: Only for a FYES server of your own (for example a local hub) that moved. The connection for {home} stays the same.

data_description.url: The web address of the FYES server, starting with https:// or http://.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach FYES. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: FYES did not accept this token.
error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired.
error.invalid_email: This does not look like an email address.
error.invalid_url: The server must be a web address that starts with https:// or http://.
error.not_allowed: This account may not connect a FYES home to Home Assistant.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

abort.already_configured: This FYES home is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This FYES home is already being set up. Finish or close that window first.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach FYES. Check the internet connection and try again.
abort.no_homes: This account has no FYES home yet.
abort.not_allowed: This account may not connect this home to Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. The FYES home is connected.
abort.too_many_tokens: This account already has the most connections for this home. Remove an old one in the FYES app (Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant), then try again.
abort.wrong_home: That sign-in belongs to a different FYES home. Sign in with an account or token for this home.

data.show_hidden: Show devices hidden in the app

data_description.show_button_events: Adds an event entity for every wall button, so automations can react to presses.
data_description.show_hidden: Adds the devices that are hidden in the FYES app.

auth_failed.message: FYES no longer accepts this connection. Sign in again from the FYES integration.

command_failed.message: FYES could not run the command: {error}

forbidden.message: Your FYES account may not control this.

gateway_offline.message: The home's FYES gateway is offline, so nothing was sent.

not_delivered.message: FYES sent the command, but the building did not confirm it: {error}

rate_limited.message: Too many commands in a short time. Try again in a minute.

security_not_allowed.message: Your FYES account may not change the security mode.

snapshot_failed.message: Could not load the FYES home: {error}
